user.title: Shelly energy monitor
user.description: Pick the two clamps' energy sensors. The **full house** clamp (120 A) is the total and is the only one that goes on Home Assistant's Energy dashboard. The **hall** clamp (50 A) is a circuit inside that total, tracked separately; the two are never added together.

channels.title: Clamp sensors
channels.description: Found automatically from each clamp's device. Change any that are wrong; leave out any you do not have. Every one of these is stored hourly and shown on the dashboard.

tariff.title: Your electricity plan
tariff.description:
Every figure INCLUDING VAT, as printed on the price sheet. Pre-filled with SSE Airtricity 30% Day Night (in force from 6 October 2026, urban Nightsaver; PSO levy €19.10 a year). Standing charge and PSO levy are per YEAR; each day is charged one 365th.

**Night hours: keep 23 and 8. Irish summer time (DST) is taken into account automatically:** night is 23:00–08:00 in winter and 00:00–09:00 in summer, switching by itself when the clocks change. Choose *Smart tariff* only if your plan's night is 23:00–08:00 on the wall clock all year.

data.night_start: Night starts (keep 23; Irish DST is taken into account)
data.night_end: Night ends (keep 8; Irish DST is taken into account)
data.bill_anchor: A date a billing period started (optional)

sse.title: SSE Airtricity meter readings
sse.description:
For sending your meter reading to SSE. A reading is ONLY sent when you press the **Submit meter reading** button; nothing is ever sent automatically, and SSE accepts one reading per 24 hours.

**Dry run** builds exactly what would be sent and shows it, without contacting SSE. **Live** signs in once now (read only) to check the details.

data.sse_sync: Once a day, read SSE's latest meter reading (read only), so readings you submit on SSE's website or app also improve the estimates

esb.title: ESB Networks
esb.description: ESB Networks publishes the meter's own half-hourly data two to three days late. It is compared with the clamp, used to calibrate the meter-reading estimate, and gives up to two years of history for the seasonal forecast. Choosing your account signs in once now to check the details. ESB rate-limits sign-ins: at most two automatic fetches a day (once is the default), at most two sign-ins in any 24 hours, and a CAPTCHA is never worked around.

data.esb_fetches_per_day: Automatic fetches (ESB publishes once a day, 2-3 days late)

reading.title: Current meter reading
reading.description: Read the day and night registers off the meter and say when. From then on the integration adds what the full-house clamp measures, in the right register, to give the meter reading as of now. {sse}

weather.title: Location and weather
weather.description:
Weather drives the forecasts (how cold it is, sun, wind, rain). The history and a 16-day forecast come from Open-Meteo (free, no key) for the spot you pin here. {origin} **Drag the pin onto your home.**

**AccuWeather:** add Home Assistant's own AccuWeather integration (Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → AccuWeather; it asks for an AccuWeather API key) and pick its weather entity below, now or later under Configure → Location and weather. Its forecast is blended with Open-Meteo's, each weighted by how well it has forecast your area.

data.weather_entity: AccuWeather (or any) forecast to blend in (optional)

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description:
A dashboard is added to the sidebar and kept up to date automatically.

**Energy dashboard:** the meter's energy (ESB's figures, the clamp until ESB has them, ESB's history before the clamp) and its energy cost at your tariff periods, both revised whenever prices change or ESB publishes. Standing charge and PSO are fixed charges and stay on the Electricity dashboard. *Replace* makes this the only grid connection and removes any other one, keeping a copy; solar, battery, gas, water and individual devices are never touched.

rates_remove.description:
{periods}

The period before it carries on in its place (or, for the first, those days have no prices). Every stored hour is re-priced at once.

rates.title: Prices
rates.description:
{periods}

Always the same four prices, **including VAT**: day rate, night rate, standing charge and PSO levy. Whichever you choose, it is stored and every stored hour is re-priced at once.

menu_options.rates_future: From a future date: today's prices carry on until then

rates_period.title: Prices for a period

rates_now.title: New prices from today
rates_now.description:
{periods}

These prices apply from today ({today}) onwards, until the next period if a later one is already set. Earlier days keep their prices.

rates_future.title: New prices from a future date
rates_future.description:
{periods}

These prices apply from the day you choose (after today, {today}); until then the current prices carry on. They run until the next period if a later one is already set.

init.title: Sign in to ESB Networks yourself
init.description: ESB Networks showed a CAPTCHA ({reason}). This integration never solves or bypasses one. Sign in at https://myaccount.esbnetworks.ie in your browser, then copy the request's Cookie header from the browser's developer tools and paste it here. ESB data resumes immediately and the session is reused.

error.no_cookies: No cookies found in what was pasted.

database_restored.title: The electricity database was repaired
database_restored.description: The database failed its integrity check at start-up: {detail}. History missing since that backup is re-read automatically from Home Assistant's recorder, ESB and the weather archive.

clock_offset.title: Home Assistant's clock is off
clock_offset.description: An NTP check against {server} found the clock {offset} s out. Day/night bands use the corrected time meanwhile, but please fix the system clock (NTP) on the host.

refresh_esb.name: Refresh ESB
refresh_esb.description: Fetch ESB Networks data now, ignoring the schedule. Use sparingly: the portal rate-limits.

rebuild.name: Rebuild history
rebuild.description: Re-read every hour the recorder holds for the clamps, re-price it, and rewrite the long-term statistics. No network access.

dashboard.name: Also regenerate the dashboard
dashboard.description: Discards hand edits to the dashboard.
